subject: Post-demo compliance synthesis & next steps (SOC 2, DPA, retention)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Miles <laura.miles@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo compliance synthesis & next steps (SOC 2, DPA, retention)

Laura — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next actions so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard (pain + goals)
- Auditability & retention: you need 7 years of immutable audit logs for ledger-related requests and 3 years for general user activity.
- SOC 2 evidence: you want proactive artifact access (scope, control mappings, and pen test summaries) to accelerate internal review.
- DPA & data residency: standard DPA with a couple of commercial redlines and a requirement to scope data flow diagrams for a subset of customer workloads.
- Pen test cadence: Horizon prefers at least annual third-party pentests with short remediation windows tied to major releases.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll share a short artifact bundle (SOC2 scope matrix, recent pen-test summary, DPA redline) — target: by EOD today (attached).
2) Irene will follow up with a short note on audit-log retention options and an example retention policy we’ve used for banks.
3) Neha to schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive next week (audit logs + retention architecture) — proposed slots Tue/Wed.
4) If the artifact set looks good, we can open a HubSpot deal and route legal to review the DPA redlines.

Attachments: SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (summary), DPA_redline_initial.docx (tracked changes)

Ask: Laura — can you confirm the internal recipients who should receive the artifact set and whether the 7-year ledger retention applies to logs that include PII?

Short sig:
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0199
From: Laura Miles <laura.miles@horizonbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance synthesis & next steps (SOC 2, DPA, retention)

Jordan — thanks for the quick recap and the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: the 7-year requirement is for financial ledger-related audit trails only. System-level request/response logs can live at the 3-year bucket, but anything that could be used for transaction reconstruction must be preserved 7 years.
- PII: ledger logs may contain masked PII; full PII is kept separately. We will still need confirmation that any logs retained for 7 years are encrypted at rest and have access controls audited.
- Pen test: we prefer a runnable executive summary (1–2 pages) and the full findings under NDA.
- DPA: I’ll have Procurement include our standard redline comments in the next email — legal will want to see indemnity and subprocessor flow.

Can you cc: procurement@horizonbank.com on the artifact bundle? Also favour a meeting on Wed morning (10/28) for the technical deep-dive — will that work?

Thanks,
Laura Miles
Director, Vendor Risk | Horizon Bank
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Miles <laura.miles@horizonbank.com>, procurement@horizonbank.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance synthesis & next steps (SOC 2, DPA, retention)

Laura / Procurement — attaching the initial artifact pack per our call. Quick notes on the attachments: 

- SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx — maps Redwood controls to common bank requirements; highlights evidence owners and expected delivery timelines.
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf — executive summary (1 page) + appendix list of testing firms; full report available under NDA (we can provide a link once NDA in place).
- DPA_redline_initial.docx — our starting point with tracked changes for the items we commonly see.

Irene — see the two customer asks above about encryption-at-rest and access controls for the 7-year ledger logs. Can you confirm the current baseline and provide a sample retention policy snippet we can share with Horizon?

Next meeting: Wed 2026-10-28 09:30–10:00 PT (technical deep-dive) — proposed. If that time doesn’t work for Horizon, Jordan can send 2 more slots.

Attachments: SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx (attachment stub), pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (attachment stub), DPA_redline_initial.docx (attachment stub)

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Miles <laura.miles@horizonbank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance synthesis & next steps (SOC 2, DPA, retention)

Hi Laura, Jordan — quick technical confirmation and a snippet you can paste into Horizon’s intake: 

1) Encryption & access controls (7-year ledger logs)
- Baseline: logs containing transaction identifiers are encrypted at rest using AES-256 with customer-specific KMS key options (we can integrate your KMS or use Redwood-managed keys).
- Access: role-based access with mutual TLS to internal collectors; audit trail for every access event retained for 3 years by default and can be extended — we can provide the expanded retention as part of the SLA.

2) Retention policy example (paste-ready):
"
Retention Scope: Transaction reconstruction logs (ledger event trails)
Retention Period: 7 years from event timestamp
Encryption: AES-256 at rest; keys managed by [Customer KMS / Redwood KMS — select option]
Access Controls: RBAC enforced; access requests logged and reviewed quarterly
Deletion: Secure purge via crypto-erase after retention period (subject to legal hold)
"

3) Pen-test artifacts
- We can provide the 1–2 page executive summary in the artifact pack (already attached). Full findings are available under NDA — JD from Legal (copied) can share a standard NDA template if needed.

4) DPA redlines
- We reviewed the redline and flagged 3 commercial points for internal review (indemnity cap, subprocessor flow-through, and data export clauses). Jordan — once we get Procurement’s redline, I’ll coordinate with Legal to produce our response draft.

I’ll join the Wed deep-dive to cover architecture and retention details. If Horizon prefers, I can pre-draft a one-page tech appendix to the DPA that captures the encryption and retention commitments.

Best,
Irene Choi
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, DPA_redline_initial.docx
